observances.title: World Television Day
observances.description: Proclaimed by the UN General Assembly to recognize television's impact on global communication, journalism, and cultural exchange.

observances.title: World Hello Day
observances.description: Encourages people around the world to greet at least ten people to demonstrate the role of personal communication in preserving peace.

observances.title: World Fisheries Day
observances.description: Highlights the critical importance of sustainable fisheries and healthy marine ecosystems for global food security.

observances.title: Armed Forces Day (Bangladesh)
observances.description: Commemorates the day in 1971 when the army, navy, and air force launched a coordinated offensive during the Liberation War.

music.title: Queen released their fourth studio album 'A Night at the Opera', featuring the six-minute suite 'Bohemian Rhapsody'.
A 17-year-old Ella Fitzgerald made her professional singing debut at the Apollo Theater's Amateur Night in Harlem.
Michael Jackson's 14-minute music video for 'Thriller', directed by John Landis, premiered in Los Angeles.

birthdays.name: René Magritte
birthdays.role: Belgian surrealist painter known for 'The Son of Man'

word.definition: The warmth of the sun felt on a crisp winter's day.
word.example: Stepping onto the morning terrace, she paused to enjoy the sudden apricity.

quote.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quote.author: Will Durant

trivia.question: Which planet in our Solar System rotates in the opposite direction to most other planets, causing the Sun to rise in the west?
trivia.explanation: Venus has a retrograde rotation, spinning clockwise on its axis once every 243 Earth days.

observances.title: Feast of Saint Cecilia (Patroness of Musicians)
observances.description: Traditionally celebrated worldwide with concerts, choral festivals, and tributes to musicians and composers.

observances.title: Lebanese Independence Day
observances.description: Commemorates the end of the French Mandate in 1943 and the recognition of Lebanon as an independent republic.

observances.title: Alphabet Day
observances.description: Marks the 1908 Congress of Manastir, which standardized the modern Latin-based Albanian alphabet.

music.title: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', in the United Kingdom.
Maurice Ravel's orchestral masterpiece 'Boléro' premiered at the Paris Opéra.
The Beatles released their second UK studio album 'With the Beatles', featuring 'All My Loving'.

birthdays.name: Billie Jean King
birthdays.role: American tennis champion & gender equality pioneer

word.definition: The realization that each random passerby is living a life as vivid and complex as your own.
word.example: Watching travelers cross the station concourse brought on a quiet wave of sonder.

quote.text: It is never too late to be what you might have been.
quote.author: George Eliot

trivia.question: Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
trivia.explanation: Canada's coastline stretches over 202,080 kilometers across the Atlantic, Pacific, and Arctic oceans.
